root.name: Ruy Lopez: Brentano Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. Bb5 g5

overview: After 3.Bb5 Black plays 3...g5, a wild counter hitting nothing but opening the kingside. White can take with 4.Nxg5 and has an extra pawn, with Black hoping for ...Qxg5 tricks and development. Strong players regard the move as bad, a surprise weapon only.

white_ideas.idea: Take the g5 pawn and develop sensibly
Hit the centre with d4 or a Bxc6 trade

black_ideas.idea: Use the open g-file and rapid development
Hope for tricks around f2 and the king

typical_structures.structure: Open game with a weakened black kingside

character.notes: A risky Black gambit that rarely works.

gambit.notes: After 4.Nxg5 White keeps the pawn with little compensation for Black.

soundness.notes: Dubious: White simply takes the pawn and has the better game.

approach.notes: Almost never played by strong players.

character.reason: Black takes a big risk for activity.

gambit.reason: Black gives the g-pawn and White can keep it.

plans.reason: Black hopes to use development for the pawn.
